dedupe_keys.name: comunidad foral de navarra drinking water datasets

description: Comunidad Foral de Navarra: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Foral de Navarra. Coverage: Comunidad Foral de Navarra. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Hidrantes de tubería. Ayuntamiento de Pamplona / Iruñeko Udala; Instalaciones. Estación de Tratamiento de Agua Potable (ETAP); Instalaciones de la Mancomunidad de Valdizarbe. Estación de Tratamient; PM. Tuberías de abastecimiento de agua. Ayuntamiento de Pamplona / Iru. Formats seen: SHP, DWG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
